# Police crime statistics: registered suspects by population group (fixture)

> **FIXTURE — not a real source.** Written for the test suite. The numbers illustrate a structure; they are not evidence about the world.

The table reports registered suspects per 100,000 residents of the same group. The
figures are counts of persons recorded by the police as suspects during the reporting
period. Non-citizens appear at a higher rate than citizens. The table does not include
any adjustment for age, sex, income or place of residence, and it does not distinguish
between persons who were later convicted and persons against whom proceedings were
dropped.
